about_pullquote: We build bathrooms people want to use and love showing off.
about_para_1: RD Luxury Bathrooms & Tiling was founded on the principle that your bathroom should reflect your taste and withstand daily wear. With over 12 years' experience across Sheffield, we've built our reputation by listening to customers, delivering on promises, and paying obsessive attention to detail. Every project, whether a small cloakroom refresh or a full-house renovation, receives the same level of craftsmanship.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we don't cut corners. We source quality materials, stick to timescales, and give honest advice about what works and what doesn't. From Southey to Dore, from terraced cottages to new-build semis, we've earned trust through transparency and exceptional results. You'll find us on site; we don't outsource the skilled work.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Absolute nightmare trying to find someone reliable for our bathroom overhaul. RD came round, listened to what we wanted, and delivered exactly that. Tiling is flawless, no mess left behind, and they finished on time. Best decision we made.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had a leaking shower enclosure from a previous job. RD came in, sorted the original problem properly, and the new tiling looks stunning. Real blokes who know their stuff and don't patronise you. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Nicola P.

reviews.text: Our downstairs cloakroom looked dated and cramped. The design consultation opened our eyes to what was possible in the space. The final result is elegant and practical. Can't recommend them highly enough.
reviews.author: David C.
